description: Opt-in staged offline lifecycle over the existing replay scheduler, with resumable graph cursor, shared-budget stage debits and advisory recombination.

microtheory.name: sleep_regime
microtheory.description: Advance one receipt-gated sleep stage per quiet epoch.

rules.name: sr_cancel_pending_cycle_on_model_epoch_change
rules.comment: Cancel a resumable sleep cursor when its provenance model epoch no longer matches the policy epoch.

rules.name: sr_begin_after_existing_replay
rules.comment: Claim a completed offline scheduler cycle after EWM has emitted its single replay receipt.

rules.name: sr_consolidate_after_semantic_receipt
rules.comment: Advance one funded, quiet-epoch sleep stage: consolidate -> decay.

rules.name: sr_decay_episodic_semantic_accessibility
rules.comment: Advance one funded, quiet-epoch sleep stage: decay -> library.

rules.name: sr_yield_to_library_learning_stage
rules.comment: Advance one funded, quiet-epoch sleep stage: library -> recombine.

rules.name: sr_recombine_as_advisory_only
rules.comment: Advance one funded, quiet-epoch sleep stage: recombine -> complete.
